summary:
THE EARTH MUSICAL 
The Earth has something to tell us. Listen to it!
Subtitle: A video game that transforms climate data into music.
Include:

Turn the visualizations from NASA’s Earth Information Center into a multisensory experience by creating an "Earth Jukebox" that transforms images of the planet into sounds generated in real time.
Our logo is about our country, our class, and our challenge.
Pato, Santi, Joaco, Guille, Diego y Santy.
